column1: # P/03.2 capture machine. One row is one transition; the first matching condition of the current state wins.
# states: admit,search,first_write,cleanup,live,rejected. Initial: admit. Terminal: live,rejected. No match: stay and wait for input, no effect.
# No state is a new row field. A rejected candidate proceeds only by the candidate order of N3; a given name never falls through to another name.
#var name_valid bool — slot-name grammar AND own manifest slot.prefix, N1.4. The adapter validates it, not an HTTP schema.
#var read_confirmed bool — the last re-read confirmed row or absence, not a store non-answer or badkey.
#var exists bool — true only for confirmed existence; a confirmed absence has initial gen zero.
#var gen_readable bool — existing gen readable by the slot family; an unreadable existing gen is never zero.
#var row_readable bool — the slot row reads by its family, N1.4; torn is exists && !row_readable with readable gen.
#var row_free bool — readable row: released true/taking/absent OR holder empty/absent. A lapsed occupied row is not free.
#var permission_matches bool — names_given contains exactly the re-read version for this candidate, N3 step 1.
#var given bool — the process has one preferred name (argument or manifest slot.name_env).
#var first_start_right bool — own-box exception from the first start; spent at the first confirmed candidate read, preserved across wholly unconfirmed reads only.
#var same_box bool — former holder box equals this box, by the instance contract; only consulted for a readable occupied row.
#var age double — seconds the same torn row VERSION has been observed on the monotonic clock. Version change resets age; never derive age from until.
#var version string — version of the confirmed re-read, empty only for confirmed absence.

#var gen_incrementable bool — verified on the exact readable generation BEFORE int conversion: true for absence, or 0 <= gen < 9007199254740991. Wide readable integers remain gen_readable=true but this is false. Never infer from a narrowed or rounded value.

#var gen int — exact readable generation only when gen_incrementable; 0 for confirmed absence or an unused placeholder when false. The adapter retains the exact original separately; no gen arithmetic is reached on an exhausted eligible candidate.
#var me string — this instance by common/contracts/instance.md.
#var server string — this server; unknown is the reader tolerance, not permission for an invalid SERVER_NAME.
#var wall double — wall seconds at the sending of a NEW write, written by P/01.1 N0 time codec.
#var reply string — pending|ok|conflict|guard|badkey|unconfirmed; a definite refusal is never unconfirmed. This is the current operation's reply.
#var cleanup_complete bool — all predecessor contributions listed AFTER first write and deleted under its guard; final released:false CAS confirmed.
#const TORN_STILL double = 50.0 — common/contracts/slot.md: Terms.
#action noop() — no store effect.
#action reject(string) — reject this candidate; bad_name with given at start exits 2; NameOnAnotherBox is the refused contender, not an exit.
#action write(string,map<string,dyn>) — CAS the slot by version, released:taking, then await its definite result. Store-item/time encoding and a logical write id are adapter duties.
#action wait() — same operation and id, first-send clock retained; do not advance or hand out live. A replay is not a new request.
#action live() — return the live slot with final-write version; own local write term is measured from FIRST SEND of that final write, not this return.
# action=- — YOURS procedure at norm; it MUST run before accepting an event in next. Never treat it as noop.
# Cleanup's YOURS procedure is N3 step 4: list, guarded delete(s), final CAS even if the list is empty. A guard/CAS refusal aborts, unconfirmed waits.
# Machine scope is one candidate. Full-key admission/badkey and all external inputs are validated by N3 Full keys and store refusal.
n

column3: exists && gen_readable && !gen_incrementable && ((!row_readable && age >= TORN_STILL) || (row_readable && (row_free || permission_matches || (given && first_start_right && same_box))))
